# pmon_policy_schema (Data Source)

The Cedar schema every policy is validated against. It names the entity types and actions a policy may reference, and is the reference for writing `cedar_src`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The entity types and actions a policy may reference.
data "pmon_policy_schema" "current" {}

output "cedar_schema" {
  value = data.pmon_policy_schema.current.schema
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `schema` (String) The Cedar schema source.
